30300.meaning1: on account of that very same lack of food

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evam'ev'assu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya. seyyathā'pi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evam'ev'assu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.
so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, imam'eva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anumajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, pāṇinā gattāni anumajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

30301.meaning1: related to stars; of a star; belonging to stars

examples.text: atthi tārakāni rūpāni, atthi tārakānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassāvī. atthi candimasūriyā, atthi candimasūriyānaṃ dassāvī.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā, sabbā tā candappabhāya kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ, candappabhā tāsaṃ aggam'akkhāyati
seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, jacc'andho puriso, so na passeyya… mañjiṭṭhakāni rūpāni, na passeyya samavisamaṃ, na passeyya tārakarūpāni, na passeyya candimasūriye.

30303.commentary: (DNa) nakkhattāni tārakarūpānī'ti kattik'ādinakkhattāni c'eva sesatārakarūpāni ca candimasūriyehi saddhiṃ'y'eva pāturahesuṃ.

examples.text: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ, moggallāna, uṭṭhāy'āsanā udakena akkhīni anumajjitvā disā anuvilokeyyāsi nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni ullokeyyāsi
ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odātanidassanāni odātanibhāsāni. seyyathā'pi nāma osadhitārakā odātā odātavaṇṇā odātanidassanā odātanibhāsā
seyyathā'pi nāma gambhīre udapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti, evam'ev'assu me akkhikūpesu akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

30308.commentary: (ITIa) tāragaṇā'va sabbe'ti yathā sabbe'pi tārāgaṇā candimasobhāya soḷasim'pi kalaṃ n'āgghanti, evaṃ te assamedh'ādayo yaññā mettacittassa vuttalakkhaṇena subhāvitassa soḷasim'pi kalaṃ n'ānubhavanti, na pāpuṇanti, n'āgghantī'ti attho.

examples.text: aṭṭh'aṅg'upetassa uposathassa, kalam'pi te n'ānubhavanti soḷasiṃ, candappabhā tāragaṇā ca sabbe, aṭṭh'aṅg'upetaṃ upavassuposathaṃ, puññāni katvāna sukhudrayāni, aninditā saggam'upenti ṭhānan'ti.
mettassa cittassa subhāvitassa, kalam'pi te n'ānubhavanti soḷasiṃ, candappabhā tāragaṇā'va sabbe.

30309.meaning1: saving; rescuing; helping to cross over

examples.text: samuggatassa jhāyissa, ananugat'antarassa suddhassa, asitassa hitassa, pavivittassa aggappattassa, tiṇṇassa tārayantassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
yaṃ me kaṅkhitam'aññāsi, vicikicchā maṃ tārayi namo te, muni monapathesu pattipatta, akhila ādiccabandhu sorato'si.
yathā'pi cando vimalo, gacchaṃ ākāsadhātuyā, sabbe tārāgaṇe loke, ābhāya atirocati.
tārāgaṇā virocanti, nakkhattā gaganamaṇḍale, visākhā candimā yuttā, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

30315.commentary: (NIDD2) anissito no visahāmi tāritun'ti. anissito'ti puggalaṃ vā anissito dhammaṃ vā anissito no visahāmi na ussahāmi na sakkomi na paṭibalo mahantaṃ kām'oghaṃ bhav'oghaṃ diṭṭh'oghaṃ avijj'oghaṃ tarituṃ uttarituṃ patarituṃ samatikkamituṃ vītivattitun'ti, anissito no visahāmi tārituṃ.

examples.text: eko ahaṃ sakka mahantam'oghaṃ, anissito no visahāmi tārituṃ, ārammaṇaṃ brūhi samantacakkhu, yaṃ nissito ogham'imaṃ tareyyaṃ.

30316.commentary: (MNa) ahaṃ pokkharasātissa, tārukkhass'āyaṃ māṇavo'ti ahaṃ pokkharasātissa jeṭṭh'antevāsī aggasisso, ayaṃ tārukkhassā'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: anuññātapaṭiññātā, tevijjā mayam'asm'ubho, ahaṃ pokkharasātissa, tārukkhass'āyaṃ māṇavo.
tuvaṃ buddho tuvaṃ satthā, tuvaṃ mār'ābhibhū muni, tuvaṃ anusaye chetvā, tiṇṇo tāresi maṃ pajaṃ.
satthā ca me lokam'imaṃ adhiṭṭhahi, aniccato addhuvato asārato, pakkhanda maṃ citta jinassa sāsane, tārehi oghā mahatā suduttarā.

30319.meaning1: to carry across; to ferry across

30320.meaning2: having made cross, having helped over, having assisted

30322.commentary: (VINa) atiṇṇe tāresī'ti saṃsārato atiṇṇe iminā jīvitāvoropanena tāresi parimocesī'ti. ayaṃ kira etissā devatāya bālāya dummedhāya laddhi, ye na matā, te saṃsārato na muttā. ye matā, te muttā'ti. tasmā saṃsāramocakamilakkhā viya evaṃladdhikā hutvā tam'pi tattha niyojentī evam'āha.

examples.text: ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna viruḷhiyā.

30324.meaning1: one palm tree in height; one palm tree deep

examples.text: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde sattatālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, chattālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, pañcatālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, catuttālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, titālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, dvitālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, tālaṃ'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti.

atha kho āyasmā mahako vihāraṃ pavisitvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhari yathā tālacchiggaḷena ca aggaḷ'antarikāya ca acci nikkhamitvā tiṇāni jhāpesi, uttar'āsaṅgaṃ na jhāpesi.
yathā haritālena makkhitaṃ, addasa cittikaṃ bhittiyā kataṃ, tamhi te viparītadassanaṃ, saññā mānusikā niratthikā.

30327.meaning2: sprout coming out of a palm nut, (which is eaten when boiled and dried)

30329.commentary: (SNa) yāvatā so tālacchāyaṃ atikkameyya, tāvatā kālena ekacakkavāḷaṃ atikkamāmī'ti attano javasampattiṃ dasseti.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo javo ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.

atha kho āyasmā mahako vihāraṃ pavisitvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhari yathā tālacchiggaḷena ca aggaḷ'antarikāya ca acci nikkhamitvā tiṇāni jhāpesi, uttar'āsaṅgaṃ na jhāpesi.

30331.meaning2: inner shell of a palm nut

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imāsu tāl'antarikāsu dhanusate dhanusate pokkharaṇiyo māpeyyan'ti.
yo ca dosaṃ pahantvāna, dosaneyye na dussati, doso pahīyate tamhā, tālapakkaṃ'va bandhanā.
esa vāt'āhatatālapaṇṇaṃ viya taṭataṭāyati, imassa kathāpariyanto'y'eva n'atthī'ti nindanti

30337.commentary: (THa) tiṇṇaṃ me tālapattānaṃ, gaṅgātīre kuṭī katā'ti tālarukkhato pahitehi tīhi tālapaṇṇehi mayhaṃ vassanapariharaṇ'atthaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre kuṭikā katā. tena attano sen'āsanasantosaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yo evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ khadirapattānaṃ vā saralapattānaṃ vā āmalakapattānaṃ vā puṭaṃ karitvā udakaṃ vā tālapattaṃ vā āharissāmī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
tiṇṇaṃ me tālapattānaṃ, gaṅgātīre kuṭī katā, chavasitto'va me patto, paṃsukūlañ'ca cīvaraṃ.
sattaratanaṃ vā, āvuso, nāgaṃ aḍḍh'aṭṭhamaratanaṃ vā tālapattikāya chādetabbaṃ maññeyya, yo me cha abhiññā chādetabbaṃ maññeyyā'ti.
ye kho pan'ānanda, tena samayena kusāvatiyā rājadhāniyā dhuttā ahesuṃ soṇḍā pipāsā, te tāsaṃ tālapantīnaṃ vāt'eritānaṃ saddena paricāresuṃ.
katvāna hammiyaṃ tattha, tālapantīhi cittitaṃ, sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā, cetiyaṃ pūjay'uttamaṃ.

30340.meaning1: name of an actor; later, name of an arahant monk
30340.meaning2: personal name of an arahant monk
30340.commentary: (SNa) tālapuṭo'ti evaṃnāmako. tassa kira bandhanā pamuttatālapakkavaṇṇo viya mukhavaṇṇo vippasanno ahosi, ten'assa tālapuṭo'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. sv'āyaṃ abhinīhārasampanno pacchimabhavikapuggalo. yasmā pana paṭisandhi nāma aniyatā ākāse khittadaṇḍasadisā, tasmā esa naṭakule nibbatti.
30340.notes: Theragāthā verses 1094-1148 (TH19.1, TH262) are attributed to him.

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho tālapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ, yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe sacc'ālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī'ti.

30343.meaning1: name of an actor; later, name of an arahant monk
30343.meaning2: personal name of an arahant monk
30343.commentary: (SNa) tālapuṭo'ti evaṃnāmako. tassa kira bandhanā pamuttatālapakkavaṇṇo viya mukhavaṇṇo vippasanno ahosi, ten'assa tālapuṭo'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. sv'āyaṃ abhinīhārasampanno pacchimabhavikapuggalo. yasmā pana paṭisandhi nāma aniyatā ākāse khittadaṇḍasadisā, tasmā esa naṭakule nibbatti.
30343.notes: Theragāthā verses 1094-1148 (TH19.1, TH262) are attributed to him.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. atha kho tālaputto naṭagāmaṇi yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

30345.meaning1: one palm tree in height; one palm tree deep

examples.text: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde sattatālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, chattālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, pañcatālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, catuttālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, titālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, dvitālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, tālamattam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti.

30346.meaning2: fan, lit. the stem of a palm-leaf

examples.text: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse tālavaṇṭena'pi vidhūpanena'pi vātaṃ pariyesanti, ossavane'pi tiṇāni na icchanti.
atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ mahāviyūhassa kūṭ'āgārassa dvāre sabbasovaṇṇamayaṃ tālavanaṃ māpeyyaṃ, yattha divāvihāraṃ nisīdissāmī'ti.

30348.commentary: (SNa) tālāvatthū bhavanti te'ti te bhikkhutejasā daḍḍhā vatthumatt'āvasiṭṭho matthakacchinnatālo viya bhavanti, puttadhīt'ādi-vasena na vaḍḍhantī'ti attho.

examples.text: yañ'ca kho sīlasampanno, bhikkhu ḍahati tejasā, na tassa puttā pasavo, dāy'ādā vindare dhanaṃ, anapaccā adāy'ādā, tāl'āvatthū bhavanti te.

30349.commentary: (ANa) tāl'āvatthukatānī'ti tālavatthu viya katāni, puna aviruhaṇ'aṭṭhena matthakacchinnatālo viya samūlaṃ tālaṃ uddharitvā tassa patiṭṭhitaṭṭhānaṃ viya ca katānī'ti attho.

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu rāgo me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo'ti pajānāti

seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna viruḷhiyā. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, sammā nibbān'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye n'evasaññā-n'āsaññ'āyatana-saṃyojane se ucchinnamūle tāl'āvatthukate anabhāvaṃkate āyatiṃ anuppādadhamme.

30350.grammar: card, fem sg, comp, abbrev of cattālīsā

examples.text: catuttālīsapadā vuttā, sandhayo pañca desitā, sallekho nāma sutt'anto, gambhīro sāgar'ūpamo'ti.

30351.commentary: (SNPa) jivhāya tālum'āhacca, udare saññato siyā'ti jivhāya tāluṃ uppīḷetvā'pi rasataṇhaṃ vinodento kiliṭṭhena maggena uppannapaccaye asevanto udare saṃyato siyā.

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā dante'bhidantam'ādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhitabbaṃ abhinippīḷetabbaṃ abhisantāpetabbaṃ.
moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, khuradhār'ūpamo bhave, jivhāya tālum'āhacca, udare saññato siyā.
a kavagga hā kaṇṭhajā, i cavagga yā tālujā, u pavaggā oṭṭhajā, ṭavagga ra ḷā muddhajā, tavagga la sā dantajā, e kaṇṭhatālujo, o kaṇṭh'oṭṭhajo, vo dant'oṭṭhajo.

30353.commentary: (SNa) atasitāye'ti atasitabbe abhāyitabbe ṭhānamhi. tāsaṃ āpajjatī'ti bhayaṃ āpajjati.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhu, assutavā puthujjano atasitāye ṭhāne tāsaṃ āpajjati. tāso h'eso bhikkhu assutavato puthujjanassa, no c'assaṃ, no ca me siyā, n'ābhavissa, na me bhavissatī'ti.

yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañ'ca devatānaṃ saddhañ'ca sīlañ'ca sutañ'ca cāgañ'ca paññañ'ca anussarati n'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, ujugatam'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tā devatā ārabbha.

30358.grammar: pron, fem dat pl of ta
30358.meaning1: to those, for those; for them
30358.commentary: (DNa) tāsaṃ dakkhiṇamādiye'ti saṅghassa dinne cattāro paccaye tāsaṃ gharadevatānaṃ ādiseyya, pattiṃ dadeyya.

examples.text: yā tattha devatā āsuṃ, tāsaṃ dakkhiṇam'ādise, tā pūjitā pūjayanti, mānitā mānayanti naṃ.

30359.grammar: pron, fem gen pl of ta

examples.text: yāvatā kho, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimuttiyo, akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggam'akkhāyati. sā kho pan'ākuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena, suññā dosena, suññā mohena.
mūlaṃ papañcasaṅkhāya, mantā asmī'ti sabbam'uparundhe, yā kāci taṇhā ajjhattaṃ, tāsaṃ vinayā sadā sato sikkhe.

30360.meaning1: of those very same; of those exact

30361.meaning1: among them I; over them I

examples.text: santi kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule khattiyakaññā'pi brāhmaṇakaññā'pi gahapatikaññā'pi, tās'āhaṃ issar'ādhipaccaṃ kāremi.

30364.grammar: pron, fem loc pl of ta
30364.meaning1: in those; in them; among them

examples.text: ucc'āvacā niccharanti, dāye aggisikh'ūpamā, nāriyo muniṃ palobhenti, tāsu taṃ mā palobhayuṃ.
so tāsu vedanāsu anicc'ānupassī viharanto, virāg'ānupassī viharanto, nirodh'ānupassī viharanto, paṭinissagg'ānupassī viharanto na kiñci loke upādiyati.

30371.meaning2: so much, so long, as far as

examples.text: yāv'assa kāyo ṭhassati tāva naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā na naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā'ti
abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya, abhabbo'va tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sot'āpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.

30372.meaning1: that much; to that extent; to that degree

examples.text: ekacce manussā evam'āhaṃsu, na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, na'pi sāmo, maṅguracchavi samaṇo gotamo'ti. yāvassu me, rājakumāra, tāva parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto upahato hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

30373.meaning1: to begin with; immediately; right away; at once

examples.text: assosi kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati, buddho kira loke uppanno'ti. tāva'd'eva ca pana bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitu'kāmo hoti.

30374.commentary: (VINa) tāvakālike'ti paṭidassāmi paṭikarissāmī'ti evaṃ gaṇhantassa tāvakālike'pi gahaṇe anāpatti.

examples.text: anāpatti sasaññissa, vissāsaggāhe, tāvakālike, petapariggahe, tiracchānagatapariggahe, paṃsukūlasaññissa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
yācitak'ūpamā kāmā tāvakālik'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti

30375.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of tāvakālika

examples.text: anāpatti ñātikāya, pārivattakaṃ parittena vā vipulaṃ, vipulena vā parittaṃ, bhikkhunī vissāsaṃ gaṇhāti, tāvakālikaṃ gaṇhāti, cīvaraṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ deti, sikkhamānāya, sāmaṇeriyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

30377.meaning1: just this much; just so much

examples.text: te mahāgovindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āhaṃsu, saṃvijjanti kho, bho, imesu sattasu rajjesu pahūtā itthiyo, tato bhoto yāvatikāhi attho, tāvatikā ānīyatan'ti. alaṃ, bho, mama'p'imā cattārīsā bhariyā sādisiyo.
alam'ettāvatā katam'ettāvatā, anuppatto no sāmaññ'attho, n'atthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyan'ti tāvataken'eva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.

30378.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of tāvataka
30378.meaning1: with just so much; merely with that
30378.meaning2: with just so much; merely with that

examples.text: evaṃ paripuṇṇañ'ca, bho ānanda, ariyaṃ sīlakkhandhaṃ ito bahiddhā aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇā attani samanupasseyyuṃ, te tāvataken'eva attamanā assu, alam'ettāvatā, katam'ettāvatā, anuppatto no sāmaññ'attho, n'atthi no kiñci uttarikaraṇīyan'ti.
na kho, gahapati, tāvataken'eva tuṭṭhi karaṇīyā, mayaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paccupaṭṭhitā cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārenā'ti.
so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, tāvataken'eva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañ'ca vadāmi theravādañ'ca, jānāmi passāmī'ti ca paṭijānāmi, ahañ'c'eva aññe ca.

30380.meaning1: that long his; that much (is) his

examples.text: ayañ'hi, deva, kumāro nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo yāvatakv'assa kāyo tāvatakv'assa byāmo, yāvatakv'assa byāmo, tāvatakv'assa kāyo
nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, yāvatakv'assa kāyo tāvatakv'assa byāmo, yāvatakv'assa byāmo tāvatakv'assa kāyo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

30381.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of tāva
30381.meaning1: so long; that far; to such an extent

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, yāvatā saññāsamāpatti tāvatā aññāpaṭivedho.
yāvatā, āvuso, channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ gati tāvatā papañcassa gati, yāvatā papañcassa gati tāvatā channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ gati.

30382.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of tāva
30382.meaning1: on that account; because of that
30382.meaning2: on that account, by that much

examples.text: na tāvatā dhammadharo, yāvatā bahu bhāsati, yo ca appam'pi sutvāna, dhammaṃ kāyena passati, sa ve dhammadharo hoti, yo dhammaṃ nappamajjati.
na tena bhikkhako hoti, yāvatā bhikkhate pare, vissaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya, bhikkhu hoti na tāvatā.

30383.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, from tāva

examples.text: yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvat'īhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti, tāvat'īhaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ.

30385.meaning2: for a period of so many days

30386.meaning1: belonging to the (Heaven of the) Thirty Three

examples.text: tena sudaṃ, bhante, devatā tāvatiṃsā attamanā honti pamuditā pītisomanassajātā dibbā vata bho kāyā paripūrenti, hāyanti asurakāyā'ti
yadā, bhante, brahmā sanaṅkumāro devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pātubhavati, na tassaṃ parisāyaṃ koci devo abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti.
sahassaṃ cātumahārājikānaṃ sahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahassaṃ yāmānaṃ sahassaṃ tusitānaṃ sahassaṃ nimmānaratīnaṃ sahassaṃ paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ.

30388.meaning1: host of the heaven of the Thirty Three
30388.meaning2: host of the heaven of the Thirty Three

examples.text: ye te, bhante, devā bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā adhun'ūpapannā tāvatiṃsakāyaṃ, te aññe deve atirocanti vaṇṇena c'eva yasasā ca.

30389.meaning1: belonging to the host of the Heaven of Thirty Three

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatā nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivutā dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāriyamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

30390.meaning1: simile of the gods of the heaven of the Thirty Three

30391.meaning1: assembly of gods in the Heaven of the Thirty Three

examples.text: aṭṭha kho imā, sāriputta, parisā. katamā aṭṭha? khattiyaparisā, brāhmaṇaparisā, gahapatiparisā, samaṇaparisā, cātumahārājikaparisā, tāvatiṃsaparisā, māraparisā, brahmaparisā, imā kho, sāriputta, aṭṭha parisā.

30392.meaning1: heavenly realm of the Thirty Three

examples.text: so taṃ gahetvā puna pucchi, atthi nu kho ito ramaṇīyataraṃ ṭhānan'ti. ath'assa tāvatiṃsabhavanaṃ kathayiṃsu, tāvatiṃsabhavanaṃ, deva, ramaṇīyataraṃ, tattha sakkassa devarañño ime cattāro mahārājāno paricārakā dovārikabhūmiyaṃ tiṭṭhanti.

30393.meaning1: (looking) like the (gods of the) Heaven of the Thirty Three
30393.meaning2: like the Heaven of the Thirty Three

examples.text: disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi, yesaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ devā tāvatiṃsā adiṭṭhapubbā, oloketha, bhikkhave, licchaviparisaṃ, apaloketha, bhikkhave, licchaviparisaṃ, upasaṃharatha, bhikkhave, licchaviparisaṃ, tāvatiṃsasadisan'ti.

30394.meaning1: lord of the heaven of the Thirty Three

examples.text: sakko ce me varaṃ dajjā, tāvatiṃsānam'issaro, t'āhaṃ bhadde vareyy'āhe, evaṃ kāmo daḷho mama.

30395.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of tāvatīha
30395.meaning1: for that many days; for so many days

examples.text: yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvat'īhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti, tāvat'īhaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ.

30398.meaning1: right then; that very instant; instantly; immediately

examples.text: avitakkaṃ samāpanno, sammāsambuddhasāvako, ariyena tuṇhībhāvena, upeto hoti tāva'd'e.
uppāṭiya cārudassanā, na ca pajjittha asaṅgamānasā, handa te cakkhuṃ harassu taṃ, tassa narassa adāsi tāva'd'e.

30399.meaning1: right then; that very instant; instantly; immediately

examples.text: tāva'd'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci
icchati ca tāva'd'eva bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
